// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The shape the PR5 widening permits: the HMAC helper only. No Prisma, no
// credentials, no address written or read. The function reads one environment
// variable and returns a hex string; it is the same category as mailStatus.
import { mailAddressHmac, mailHmacConfigured } from "@/lib/mailHmac";

export function isConfigured(): boolean {
  return mailHmacConfigured();
}

export function hmacFor(address: string): string | null {
  return mailAddressHmac(address);
}
